note: No DataDecide downstream or benchmark accuracy was opened or used. Orders list recipe names from predicted best (lowest statistic) to worst.
direction: lower statistic predicts higher accuracy, for all three predictors

predictors.ours_M_task: bigram cross-entropy of the task text under the recipe sample's bigram model (datadecide_stats.Bigram, abs. discount 0.75, trained on the first 90% of the sample, as in its xent command), bits/token
predictors.rival_unigram_ce: unigram cross-entropy of the task text under the recipe sample's token frequencies (DataDecide tokenizer, add-0.5 smoothing), bits/byte; the code of data_choice_stats.unigram, the unigram_ce rival of forecast_primary_mismatch.json
predictors.secondary_M_mix11: mismatch to the 11 DataDecide eval sets: mean over eval sets e of (xent[recipe][e] - xent[e][e]) / bytes_per_token[e] (results/datadecide/stats/xent.json), the mismatch_all statistic of datadecide_predict.py, bits/byte; same for every task

task_text: question plus all answer options per instance (BoolQ: passage, question, 'yes no'; HellaSwag: ctx and the four endings; WinoGrande: sentence with blank and both options; PIQA: goal and both solutions; Social IQa: context, question and three answers); full OLMES split
